AnnualCrop.description: Agricultural land used for annual crops like wheat, corn or rice.

Forest.description: Dense tree cover -- natural or planted forest areas.

HerbaceousVegetation.description: Low-lying vegetation like grasslands and shrubs.

Industrial.description: Industrial zones, factories and manufacturing areas.

Pasture.description: Open grassland used for livestock grazing.

PermanentCrop.description: Land with permanent crops like vineyards or orchards.

Residential.description: Urban residential areas and housing settlements.

River.description: Rivers, streams and flowing water bodies.

SeaLake.description: Large water bodies including seas, lakes and reservoirs.
